assessment.scope: 对象为ACT等承担标准化考试的美国私营/非营利考试公司；触发条件为机构自身（而非外部个人或泄题者）弄虚作假被揭露；观察口径为是否出现业务大量流失、合同/客户终止、收入骤降乃至公司垮台或破产。观察时段为1991年出版至2026-11-09截止日。
assessment.reason: 原文是条件性判断：只有考试公司自身弄虚作假被揭露，才可能因失去业务而垮台。现有证据主要涉及外部泄题、考试取消、安全部门调整和行业性收入下滑，未见ACT自身造假被证实的记录，触发条件未满足。
assessment.limitation: 条件未发生，无法检验“造假→业务流失→垮台”的因果链；ACT后续被私募收购、与ETS合并等属于行业与经营变化，不能当作自身造假的结果。
assessment.method: 信誉损失通过业务收入影响机构生存

evidence_notes.quote: ACT承认2016年6月因已核实试题泄露取消韩国和香港考试；11月宣布韩国考点集中于一个由ACT直接监督的地点，以应对重复材料泄露。
evidence_notes.limitation: 属外部泄题与考试取消，非ACT自身造假；仅说明安全事件，不证明业务垮台。

evidence_notes.quote: Standardized testing giant ACT Inc continues to partner with Asian test-preparation operators, despite widespread cheating at overseas education centres it licenses.
evidence_notes.limitation: 报道的是海外考点作弊与合作伙伴关系，非ACT自身造假；且显示ACT仍在运营合作。

evidence_notes.quote: ACT Inc, maker of America’s most popular university entrance exam, is laying off its head of test security and plans to audit nearly 200 education centres after Reuters detailed widespread cheating in an ACT-owned college-prep program for international students.
evidence_notes.limitation: 涉及外部作弊与安全整改，非机构自身造假被证实；不能作为垮台证据。

evidence_notes.quote: The revenues generated by ACT Inc. from educational assessment and work-force development — a category that includes the ACT exam — declined by nearly $100 million during just the fiscal year that ended on August 31, 2020.
evidence_notes.limitation: 收入下降主要归因于疫情与考试可选政策，非自身造假所致；不能支持条件性因果判断。

evidence_notes.quote: Two years after 67-year-old ACT was taken over by a private equity firm, educational nonprofit ETS this week announced it’s acquiring the college- and career-readiness assessment company in Iowa City — merging two testing giants into one mammoth assessment organization reaching 35 million people a year.
evidence_notes.limitation: ACT被收购合并而非垮台，但原因是行业与经营变化，非自身造假；仅作反证参考。

evidence_notes.quote: After years of losses, the nonprofit ACT is moving the test into a for-profit corporation that will be majority owned by Nexus Capital Management.
evidence_notes.limitation: 显示ACT长期亏损并转为营利公司，但未证实自身造假；不能直接证明或证伪条件判断。

evidence_notes.quote:
The 2017 fall retake test misadministration at two Tennessee schools appears to have 
stemmed from a failure of the schools to correctly communicate their desired test date to 
ACT.
evidence_notes.limitation: 属考试管理失误而非机构造假；日期未知，仅作边界参考。
